safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not document 'no unwell contacts' or 'no nausea/vomiting' (only asks/mentions GI diarrhea and appetite).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “no unwell contacts” and “no nausea/vomiting” reduces completeness of the infectious-symptom review and exposure history, which can modestly affect differential considerations (e.g., viral gastroenteritis/COVID exposure) and counseling. In this presentation, the impact is limited because other key respiratory and systemic symptoms were still captured and these negatives are not typically decision-critical for immediate management.
